title: Philosophy, B.A. -- General Philosophy Option (College of the Liberal Arts)
notes: General Philosophy Option (of six: General Philosophy, Humanities and Arts, Philosophy of Science and Mathematics, Social Sciences, Professional Studies, Justice/Law/Values -- General Philosophy chosen as the simplest, and each of the six options names real enumerated course pools, unlike Art B.A./B.F.A.'s unresolvable concentrations, so this is not a data-ambiguity wall). Entrance to major requires a 2.00 GPA and third-semester classification, not modeled directly. All PHIL courses used here (PHIL 12, PHIL 200-204, and the various PHIL 4xx courses) were already fully cataloged in phil_catalog.json from an earlier build, all with no enforced prereqs. 'LA 283' (the same unconfirmed code hit in the History/Criminology/Sociology/English builds) replaced with a generic 'Second-Year Liberal Arts Seminar' slot. 'PHIL Concentration Course (PHIL 200-204 level)' (2 occurrences), '1-100 level PHIL Course' (1 occurrence), and 'PHIL 400-level Concentration Course' (5 occurrences) are modeled as generic slots, matching the bulletin's own open-range phrasing for these categories. Semester 1's own itemized courses summed 3cr short of the bulletin's stated 17.5cr total -- closed with one additional generic Gen Ed slot, the same minor source-reconciliation gap hit repeatedly this session. Re-verified against philosophy.la.psu.edu's own per-option curriculum pages (a real department handbook exists beyond the bulletin). Found the biggest bug of this whole verification pass: none of the PHIL-requirement slots were wired to the engine's picker at all -- bare generic slots with no options/gen_ed/open_elective key, so they were permanently unfillable placeholders (the same bug class as CMPSC's original Gen Ed gap). Also found the credit-bucket structure itself was wrong: the department's real structure is PHIL 12 (3cr, prescribed) + 6cr at 000/100-level (2 courses, not 1) + 12cr at ANY 200-level (4 courses, not 2, and not restricted to 200-204 specifically -- PHIL 205/208/233/242N also count) + 9cr at 400-level (3 courses, not 5) = 30cr major total. Fixed: '1-100 Level PHIL Course' now enumerates the real list (PHIL 1-15/20/60N, excluding PHIL 83 which is a First-Year Seminar not a content course, and PHIL 98 which is Independent Study) and appears twice; 'Concentration Course' now enumerates the real any-200-level list (PHIL 200/201/202/203/204/205/208/233/242N) and appears four times; the 400-level slots were cut from 5 to 3 and wired via open_elective (elective_min_level: 400, elective_exclude: PHIL 494/494H/496/497/499 -- the special-topics/independent-study exclusion, same pattern as CMPSC's handbook fix). Net +3cr from the corrected bucket sizes was offset by trimming one generic Elective from each of two semesters and converting the now-excess 400-level slot in Semester 8 to a plain Elective, keeping the plan's total credits and 8-semester shape unchanged.
